title: Leakage-Audited Solar Flare Forecasting Across Solar Cycles 24 and 25: code and result tables
description: Code, GitHub Actions workflows, result tables and figures for M+ solar flare forecasting (24 h horizon) from SDO/HMI SHARP parameters: leakage audit of random, HARP-grouped and forward-in-time evaluation, transfer between Solar Cycles 24 and 25 (to December 2025), and a label audit showing that the SWAN-SF flare list carries the operational 0.7 GOES XRS-B scaling. Version 2 relabels both cycles from the NOAA GOES Flare Report in true flux.
